adjudication.rationale:
In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, both `updateEvent` and `deleteEvent` compute the fallback calendar ID like:

```ts
const calendarId = externalCalendarId
  ? externalCalendarId
  : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId;
```

When `externalCalendarId` is falsy (the else branch), the `find` compares `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` where `externalCalendarId` is `undefined`/`null`, so it will not match any real calendar and yields `undefined`. This defeats the intended fallback to the event’s destination calendar and can cause the delete/update to target the wrong calendar (likely falling back elsewhere to `primary`), leaving non-primary events undeleted/orphaned when references lack `externalCalendarId`.
